Committed as `57bed45`, not pushed, per instructions.

## Summary

**Story:** `add-upstream-error-code` from epic `fix-startrun-heimdall-routing`, on branch `feat/fix-startrun-heimdall-routing`.

**Changes:**
- `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/pantheon/minerva/src/errors.ts` — added `UPSTREAM_ERROR` as the 6th value to the `ErrorCode` union (only change made to this file).
- `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/pantheon/minerva/src/dispatch.ts` — imported `HeimdallRouteError` from `./driver.ts`; in the handler-catch branch only, added an `instanceof HeimdallRouteError` check that maps to `{code: "UPSTREAM_ERROR", message: e.message}`. The genuine "no such method" branch (lines ~60-69) is untouched; everything else in the catch branch still falls back to `UNKNOWN_METHOD`.
- `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/pantheon/minerva/src/types.test.ts` — updated the pre-existing exhaustive-switch closed-enum test (`ErrorCode is closed to exactly these five values`) to cover the new 6-value union. This was required — without it, `tsc --noEmit` fails because the switch's `default` branch is no longer unreachable (`never` type error).

**New test file:** `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/pantheon/minerva/src/dispatch.test.ts` (this file didn't previously exist — dispatch had no dedicated test file). Two tests:
1. Injects a fake `Driver` (via the existing `__setDriverForTest` test seam in `kickoff-engine.ts`) whose `runTurn()` throws a `HeimdallRouteError`, calls `dispatch({method: "startRun", ...})`, and asserts the response is `{error: {code: "UPSTREAM_ERROR", ...}}`.
2. Calls `dispatch({method: "thisMethodDoesNotExist"})` and asserts the response is unchanged: `{error: {code: "UNKNOWN_METHOD", ...}}`.

**Verification:**
- `npx tsx --test src/dispatch.test.ts` — both tests pass.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors.
- Also ran `npx tsx --test src/dispatch.test.ts src/types.test.ts` together — all 28 tests pass (confirms the closed-union test update didn't break anything else in `types.test.ts`).
- Note: I did not run the full `src/*.test.ts` suite — it includes `kickoff-engine.test.ts`, which spawns real `claude` subprocesses making real API calls, unrelated to this story's scope and not requested by the story. I started it, saw it was expensive/slow, and killed it rather than let it run unnecessarily.

**Open item flagged (not resolved, per story scope):** Open Question 6 from the design discussion — whether downstream Pantheon consumers that pattern-match on the previous 5-value `ErrorCode` union need advance notice of this new 6th value — is unresolved and noted in the commit message for epic-owner visibility.

**Note on the working tree:** `src/kickoff-engine.ts` and `src/kickoff-engine.test.ts` have unstaged local modifications that I did not make and did not touch or commit — these appear to be from another concurrent agent/teammate active in this shared working directory (the `.pHive/agent-complete/` directory was actively growing with new entries during this session). Only the 4 files listed above were staged and committed.
